title: How Workers works
author: Cloudflare
why: The primary explanation of V8 isolates, why they start fast, and how they differ from containers and VMs.

title: How KV works
author: Cloudflare
why: A clear vendor description of an eventually consistent edge store: where reads are served from and how long writes take to propagate.

title: ESI Language Specification 1.0
author: W3C Note (Akamai, Oracle and others, 2001)
why: The original idea of assembling cached fragments at the edge, still the mental model behind edge-side composition.

title: RFC 5861: HTTP Cache-Control Extensions for Stale Content
author: M. Nottingham (IETF, 2010)
why: Defines stale-while-revalidate and stale-if-error, the two directives that let edge caches hide origin latency and outages.
